dispositions.subject: forward-order local polarity
dispositions.evidence: A negated checkout predicate no longer licenses a later positive payment predicate across causal, comma, yet/or/sau or related connectors.

dispositions.subject: new modal-negative forms
dispositions.evidence: Added EN/RO may-not, might-not, poate-să-nu and ar-putea-să-nu limitations are admitted.

dispositions.subject: reverse-order mixed-polarity leak
dispositions.evidence: In `Payment is not available, but checkout happens...`, the `not` belonging to the earlier payment predicate is treated as a preceding negation for the later positive checkout predicate. The Romanian `Plata nu este disponibilă, dar checkout are loc...` has the same defect.

dispositions.subject: direct postfix negative regression
dispositions.evidence: The replacement after-pattern omits prior `cannot`, `can't`, `does not`, `doesn't`, and `isn't` forms, rejecting legitimate negative limitations whose financial term comes first.

dispositions.subject: full44 service and real POST
dispositions.evidence: Defining service/route code is unchanged; exact LIVE28 recovery, reviewed fallback and persisted model accounting remain covered by the 460-test affected frame.

dispositions.subject: source/action and safety precedence
dispositions.evidence: The two-file delta does not change source/action, credential, private-data, injection or security logic.

dispositions.subject: Screenshot30
dispositions.evidence: The complete full-answer screenshot and its binding remain unchanged.

dispositions.subject: runtime and checkpoint status
dispositions.evidence: Static review only; preview rebind, runtime, actual31, capacity, readiness, completion and acceptance remain later gates.

dispositions.evidence: No destination is inferred and no CP2 authorization follows.
